description_expanded: Welcome to The Brown PelicanTucked inside the charming Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community along Scenic 30A, The Brown Pelican is the kind of beach cottage guests return to year after year. Just minutes from the sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf waters, this 3BR/3BA coastal retreat blends upscale style with relaxed beach living.Inside, you’ll find a bright open floor plan, rich hardwood floors, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious kitchen perfect for gathering after a day in the sun. The living area is designed for comfort, with plush seating and flat-screen TVs for movie nights or game days. The oversized screened-in porch — breezy, peaceful, and made for slow mornings, afternoon naps, and laughter-filled evenings. Whether you're biking along 30A, poolside with the kids, beach hopping, or exploring nearby coastal towns, this home is your perfect home base.Why Guests Love The Brown Pelican!-Less than 5 minute walk to Seabreeze Public Beach Access-Beautiful, high-end interior with coastal charm-4 bikes included plus an outdoor shower-Spacious, charming screened-in porch perfect for relaxing-Dog friendly (additional $250 fee and restrictions apply)-Community pool just steps away (seasonally heated)Just 1 mile to The Big Chill for dining, shopping, and entertainment-Minutes to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Seaside-Professionally managed with 24/7 guest service*Sleeps Up to 10 Guests*Master Bedroom: King Bed + Private BathGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed + Private BathGuest Bedroom: Two Full BedsLiving Room: Sleeper Sofa*Traveling With Your Dog?We happily welcome up to two dogs (75 lb limit each). A non-refundable pet fee applies. Please contact reservations within 24 hours of booking to add your furry family member.* Snowbird Friendly!January–February monthly stays available at discounted winter rates. Perfect for long beach walks, peaceful mornings, and escaping the cold.About Magnolia Cottages by the SeaThis quiet, picturesque 30A community offers:* Beach access* Seasonally heated pool* A peaceful, tucked-away feel* Prime location near all the action Area HighlightsRosemary Beach – Stroll cobblestone streets, boutique shop, grab coffee, or dine al fresco in the European-inspired town center.The Big Chill – A must-visit hub for tacos, burgers, cocktails, movies on the lawn, concerts, and family fun.Grouper Reef – One of South Walton’s artificial snorkeling reefs, teeming with marine life. Best accessed with a paddleboard, kayak, or flotation device. Read less
